CustomObject.description: Signing secrets for inbound integrations. Protected on purpose: protected custom metadata is readable by Apex in this org but not queryable out of it by a user, which is exactly the shape needed for a secret that guest-reachable code must read. The type and its fields are source-controlled; the RECORDS never are - see the customMetadata entry in .forceignore and .gitignore.
CustomObject.label: Integration Secret
